mission_07: Well done! You have successfully applied Recursive Feature Elimination for wrapper-based feature selection. You learned how RFE iteratively removes the least important features based on model coefficients, ranks all features, and selects the optimal subset. RFE considers feature interactions, making it more powerful than univariate methods. The trade-off is computational cost, as RFE fits the model multiple times. Use RFE when you have moderate feature counts and want a feature subset optimized for a specific model. For large feature sets, consider RFECV which automatically determines the optimal number of features via cross-validation.
